messages:
laura: Quick flag for month-close 00: invoice INV-2028-2765 (Nimbus Labs) $210,000 posted today. Appears system mapped entire amount to professional services revenue. Contract is multi-element: $60k one-time services + $150k 12-month reserved capacity. Need allocation + JE to correct.

jon: Can you paste the invoice lines and the contract clause on allocation? We need support for audit.

laura: Lines: 
- Line 1: Professional services 60000 USD (item: svc-setup)
- Line 2: Dedicated capacity prepaid 150000 USD (item: ded-cap)
No credits. Contract SOW section 3 says capacity recognized over 12 months from effective 2028-05-01. Services recognized at completion (already delivered). System bug: invoice parser flagged both lines as service.

accounting-bot: Invoice INV-2028-2765 posted 2028-04-29T14:05:22Z by billing-worker. Allocated_rev_code: SVC_ONLY (automated tag).

priya: Proposed accounting: leave services recognized (60k) but reclass the 150k to deferred revenue. JE to reclass full 150k at month-end.

laura: Proposed JE draft: 
Date: 2028-04-30
Journal: ADJ-ME-2028-04-NIMBUS01
Debit 4100 Recognized Revenue       150,000.00
Credit 2200 Deferred Revenue       150,000.00
Memo: Reclass prepaid capacity from recognized to unearned (INV-2028-2765).

jon: Also update RevAlloc table to map item ded-cap -> 12mo schedule start 2028-05-01. If we don't fix mapping the rev-rec batch will re-recognize next run. Who's owner?

laura: I'll update RevAlloc and add a governance note. Will attach the contract excerpt and updated mapping screenshot to the JE.

priya: For GLs confirm 4100 is our revenue recognized code and 2200 is deferred. Tag JE with team tag: ME-APR-Adj2.

tom: Do we need to touch ARR calculation? The committed ARR should reflect the capacity annualized, but services are not ARR. Reconciler needs flag.

laura: Good call. I'll add a note for ARR pipeline: capacity portion should be included in committed ARR for sales metrics. I'll add a line in the rollforward: +150k allocated to ARR starting May.

accounting-bot: JE ME-APR-Adj2 created as draft by laura at 2028-04-30T18:10:00Z. Pending approval.

jon: Approving contingent on attachments. Please include invoice PDF, SOW excerpt, and RevAlloc screenshot. Also include who on sales confirmed capacity start date.

laura: Sales (tom) confirmed start 2028-05-01 per email thread. Attaching docs now and routing JE for approval. JE posted as NS-592040.

priya: Verified mapping updated in RevAlloc. Run a test rev rec cycle and attach summary.

tom: Test rev run looks good: March/April unaffected, May recognized revenue will include $12.5k monthly (150k/12). Services recognized remain at 60k.

jon: OK. Add this to the month-end memo under 'Significant Adjustments' with links to docs. Closing when NS-592040 is approved.

laura: NS-592040 approved by jon at 2028-05-01T09:03:17Z. Done.
